title: tess-cloud-pipeline: Automated TESS Light-Curve Mining, Vetting, and Candidate Classification
description: An automated astronomical data-mining pipeline that ingests, detrends, and analyzes high-cadence NASA TESS photometry to detect stellar variability, eclipsing binaries, and isolated transit-like events with automated physical vetting, Target Pixel File difference imaging, and multi-catalog cross-matching.
